definitions.explanation: Moving away from or going beyond established norms, rules, or expected paths.

examples.japanese: ルールから{逸脱|いつだつ}した{行為|こうい}だ。
examples.english: That's an act that deviates from the rules.

examples.japanese: {話|はなし}が{本題|ほんだい}から{逸脱|いつだつ}している。
examples.english: The discussion is straying from the main topic.

examples.japanese: {常識|じょうしき}を{逸脱|いつだつ}した{発言|はつげん}。
examples.english: A statement that departs from common sense.

notes:
WORD STRUCTURE:
{逸|いつ} (deviate, escape) + {脱|だつ} (escape, slip out)
Both characters convey the idea of going beyond boundaries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・ルールから{逸脱|いつだつ}する - to deviate from rules
・{軌道|きどう}を{逸脱|いつだつ}する - to go off track
・{本題|ほんだい}から{逸脱|いつだつ}する - to stray from the main topic
・{常識|じょうしき}を{逸脱|いつだつ}する - to depart from common sense
・{範囲|はんい}を{逸脱|いつだつ}する - to exceed the scope

NUANCE:
Usually carries a negative connotation, implying that deviating from the norm is problematic or unacceptable. Can be neutral when describing digressions in conversation.

REGISTER:
Formal. Common in legal, academic, and business contexts.
